from kin import *
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
# x: body pitch, hip, knee, shoulder pitch, roll, yaw, elbow,wrist yaw, wrist2,wrist1
lo=[0,-2.7,.3,-2.87,-.34,-1.3,-1.25,-.15,-.5236,-.6981]
hi=[1.5,0,2.05,2.87,1.5,2,2.61,1.57,.1745,.4887]
def make(x):
 p,h,k,sp,sr,sy,e,w,w2,w1=x; a=np.zeros(61);a[2]=a[7]=h;a[3]=a[8]=k;a[4]=a[9]=-p-h-k;a[11:16]=[sp,sr,sy,e,w];a[16:21]=[sp,-sr,-sy,e,w]; a[21:23]=[w2,w1];a[41:43]=[w2,w1];return a

def err(x,target,angle):
 a=make(x);base,com,hands=body(a,x[0]);T=fk(qfull(a));R=Rotation.from_euler('y',x[0]).as_matrix()@T[links.index('lh_palm'),:3,:3];
 goalR=Rotation.from_euler('y',angle).as_matrix()
 return np.r_[10*(hands[0]-target),4*(com[0]-.08),2*Rotation.from_matrix(goalR.T@R).as_rotvec(),max(0,-.87-a[4])*10,max(0,a[4]-.52)*10,.015*x]
if __name__=='__main__':
 best=None
 for i in range(8):
  x0=np.array([1,-1.8,2,.1,.05,0,.7,0,0,.4])+np.random.normal(0,.1,10);x0=np.clip(x0,np.array(lo)+.001,np.array(hi)-.001)
  sol=least_squares(err,x0,bounds=(lo,hi),args=([.5,.214,.20],.75),max_nfev=200)
  if best is None or np.linalg.norm(sol.fun)<np.linalg.norm(best.fun):best=sol
 x=best.x;a=make(x);print('cost',np.linalg.norm(best.fun),'x',x,'base,com,hands',body(a,x[0]));print('a',a[:23]);np.save('/app/output/grasp.npy',a);np.save('/app/output/grasp_x.npy',x)
